metrics.help: Whether the node is running (1) or not (0). Converted from the boolean 'running' field.

notes: All endpoints use HTTP Basic auth on port 15672. /api/queues and /api/nodes return arrays; each element yields a series labelled by queue+vhost or node respectively. message_stats may be absent on objects with no activity yet, so message_stats-derived metrics are required=false. Node 'running' is boolean and is converted to 0/1. Node uptime is exposed as a gauge in milliseconds as reported by the API (docs do not state it is a counter). String fields (rabbitmq_version, erlang_version, state) are not exported as metrics.
